title: Embossed paper proof
description: A movable studio light reveals the shallow relief of a blind-embossed mark on blue paper.
useCase: Interactive material proofs, print finishing previews, and direct two-dimensional light controls.
interaction: Drag the light or move it with arrow keys
reducedMotion: Light, relief shading, and cast shadow follow input immediately; no idle animation or transition.
limitations: SVG point-light diffuse shading over an authored height mask with an approximate projected card shadow. No arbitrary 3D scene, uploaded material, or physically based renderer.
look: Matte mid-blue paper card with a blind-embossed nested-arch mark and fine grain, floating on a dark teal-black ground beside a small sun handle.
motion: Dragging the sun handle or pressing arrow keys moves an SVG point light; the embossed arches re-shade, a light pool follows and the card's blurred shadow shifts opposite, without easing.
adapt: Lighting is the `relief` filter: `feDiffuseLighting` with an `fePointLight` at `light.x`/`light.y`, while `shadow` offsets the cast shadow by `0.047` per unit. Tune `surfaceScale`, `diffuseConstant` and `lightingColor`; replace the three arch `path` shapes and `#275381` paper with your mark.
